entries.text: Two men-- young, idealistic, the fine product of a generation hardened by world war. Two fathers, whose paths would converge in a new battle-- an invisible war between a silent enemy and a sleeping giant... On a scale to dwarf all historical conflicts. A 50-years war. Its killing fields lying in wait... For the inevitable global holocaust.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Theirs was the dawn of armageddon. And while the world was unaware, unwitting spectators... To the hurly-burly of the decade's long struggle... Between heaven and earth, there were those who prepared for the end-- who measured the size and power of the enemy and faced the choices: stand and fight, or bow to the will of a fearsome enemy. Or to surrender; to yield and collaborate; to save themselves and stay their enemy's hand. Men who believed that victory was the absence of defeat, and survival the ultimate ideology... No matter what the sacrifice.

entries.text: [ gunfire continues ] what the hell is that?
entries.speaker: Doctor

entries.text: I think this is him.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You gonna tell me what the hell is going on?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Our lives are in danger.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Why couldn't you tell me that over the phone?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: If somebody overheard us, it might create mass panic.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mass panic? Over what?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: El rico air base.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We waited to send our communication.
entries.speaker: First Elder

entries.text: We were worried something had happened.
entries.speaker: Elder 3

entries.text: Shots were fired at us.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: By who?
entries.speaker: Elder 3

entries.text: I don't know. We have people missing. Where's Alex Krycek?
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: [ yelling ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Krycek! I'm trying to get out of here.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: We can't get past security. They won't recognize my authority to remove a patient. My father did this to her. She wants to tell her story.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Sorry son of a bitch. You don't get it, do you? It's all going to hell. The rebels are gonna Win. They took it.
entries.speaker: Alex Krycek

entries.text: They took what?
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: [ tires screech ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Who sent the communications?
entries.speaker: Elder 3

entries.text: No one.
entries.speaker: Elder 4

entries.text: This isn't supposed to be.
entries.speaker: First Elder

entries.text: What is this?
entries.speaker: Elder 3

entries.text: Back. Back. Back, back, back!
entries.speaker: First Elder

entries.text: [ chattering, shouting ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Back! Back!
entries.speaker: First Elder

entries.text: [ tires screeching ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ screaming, yelling ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: The way these people died, the loss of life here, it is beyond words. I can't imagine how it must be for you, losing your mother.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Yes, sir. But that's not why I asked for this meeting.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Why did you ask for it?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Because I'm responsible for the deaths of those people... At the air base hangar in no small way. I certainly didn't prevent them.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: I can assume then you can explain how they died? Because I've yet to hear any explanation.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Agent Mulder can explain it. I think agent Scully to an extent. They might have even prevented what you see in those photos.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Agents Scully and Mulder have been suspended by the FBI
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Also my doing. And my mistake.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: I would ask--
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: I'd ask, sir, before you tell me that it's not my business, that you do everything you can to get them back on the X-Files. Far worse can happen. And it will.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Where are you going?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: To pack up my office.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Agent Spender! You have answers now? Why didn't I hear about those answers before?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: I've had answers for years.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Then why didn't we hear about them?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Nobody ever listened.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Who burned those people?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: They burned themselves... With a choice made long ago by a conspiracy of men... Who thought they could sleep with the enemy, only to awaken another enemy.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What the hell does that mean?
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: It means the future is here, and all bets are off.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Scully, make some sense.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Sir, I wouldn't bet against him.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Get out of here.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: This picture you have, I haven't seen it since you were born. You probably don't even know who the other man is.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I don't care. Get out.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: It's bill Mulder, Fox Mulder's father. Isn't that something? He was a good man, a friend of mine, who betrayed me in the end.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I know more than enough about your past, enough to hate you.
entries.speaker: Jeffrey Spender

entries.text: Your mother was right. I came here hoping otherwise. Hoping that my son... Might live to honor me...
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: [ cocks weapon ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Like bill Mulder's son.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: [ gunshot ]
entries.speaker: Sound
